destRootHint: Prefer another disk. The destination must be outside your workspace.
pickerUnavailable: System folder picker unavailable, please type the path manually
idleHint: Scheduled backups wait until idle; 0 means no waiting.
autoStart: Start auto backup when SiYuan launches
dailyFirst: Back up once on the first launch each day
hardlinkHint: Unchanged files are hard-linked, so total usage is far below count × size.
noSource: Pick a backup scope in settings first
snapshotsHint: Each snapshot can be exported independently. Verify before restoring. Written means bytes copied when the snapshot was created.
deleteConfirm: Deletion cannot be undone. Delete snapshot
restoreExportHint: Copy the whole snapshot to a folder of your choice. Safe, workspace untouched.
exportInsideWorkspace: Export target must be outside the workspace
restoreOverwriteHint: Overwrites the workspace with this snapshot. A safety snapshot is taken automatically first. Restart SiYuan afterwards.
overwriteWarn: This will overwrite the workspace with snapshot
overwriteWarn2: A safety snapshot is taken first. Continue?
safetyFailed: Safety snapshot failed. Restore aborted, your data is untouched.
restoreFailed: Export incomplete; do not use it for recovery
restartNow: Please restart SiYuan to rebuild indexes. Safety snapshot:
lastBackupFailed: The last backup did not complete
firstBackupHint: Choose a destination outside your workspace, then select Save and back up.
runningHint: A snapshot is published only after validation. You can cancel safely.
retentionHint: Off by default: all history is kept. When enabled, only a successful backup triggers pruning. Prefer the latest 10, then one per day, subject to the limit.
waitOperation: Wait for the current operation to finish.
saveFailed: Settings could not be saved. Check workspace permissions.
invalidDestination: Enter an absolute path outside your workspace.
invalidNumber: Enter valid integers: non-negative times and at least one snapshot.
statsFastHint: Only snapshot manifests are read. Use Verify in snapshot management to check file integrity.
incompleteHint: incomplete or invalid snapshots were preserved. They cannot be restored or automatically pruned. Open their folders to inspect them.
emptySnapshotHint: Create your first backup to verify, export and browse older versions here.
verifying: Reading files and checking their contents…
legacyVerify: Legacy snapshot: structure and size only; no original content fingerprints.
invalidSnapshot: Invalid manifest. The snapshot has been preserved for inspection.
safeRestoreIntro: The snapshot is checked before export and copied into independent files. Inspect your notes and assets before replacing the workspace.
restoreStep1: Choose a destination. A new folder will be created for this snapshot.
restoreStep2: Check the exported files, then completely quit SiYuan.
restoreStep3: Keep the current workspace folders as a fallback. Replace the corresponding folders with the exported ones, then reopen SiYuan.
offlineRestoreHint: SiYuan keeps writing while running, so live overwrite is disabled. Export does not delete current notes or notes added since the snapshot.
exportOutside: Choose a location outside the workspace and backup folder.
overviewIntro: Check your latest backup and keep your work within reach.
planIntro: Choose a backup rhythm that works while SiYuan is idle.
autoStartDetail: Use the interval above after SiYuan becomes idle.
dailyFirstDetail: Independent of the schedule; recorded only after success.
scopeIntro: Choose what to keep. Include notes and attachments for everyday backups.
scopeDataDetail: Notebooks, images, documents and plugins · data
scopeConfDetail: Appearance, shortcuts and workspace settings · conf
scopeHistoryDetail: Historical edits; may use significant space · history
scopeRepoDetail: SiYuan repository; confirm the directory exists · repo
minimizeHint: Minimize to a restore bar; background tasks continue
closeWindowHint: Close this window; background tasks continue
topbarHint: Click to open the workbench; right-click for quick actions
searchSnapshotPlaceholder: Search date, snapshot name or note
noMatchingSnapshots: No matching snapshots. Try another date or keyword.
